description: Graph RAG memory for AI agents on one SQLite file: vector retrieval, hand-curated wikilink graph, cross-encoder rerank, zero-token per-turn ledger, MCP server, and memory-bench v0.1.
rules: Install with pip install sqlite-graph-memory; indexing and rerank need the [embeddings] extra.
The MCP server entry point is sgm-mcp; it exposes one tool, memory_recall.
Markdown notes are canonical; the SQLite file holds derived state (turns ledger, ab_recall telemetry).
